notes: An example overlay, not a statement about any analyser. The driver refuses every numeric write (MHS.SAFETY.LIMITS_UNSET) until the operator states the ranges of the unit at this site; this file shows the shape of that overlay. The example ranges describe a bench that uses the analyser over 0.9 to 1.1 GHz with spans of 1 MHz to 200 MHz, a center step of 1 kHz to 1 MHz, 101 to 10001 sweep points and a 1 to 60 s timeout.
